_claims.claim: Sonnet: full_trace ranks hacks better than final_report (AUROC).
_claims.evidence: corrected auroc: 0.891 vs 0.825, Δ +0.066 [+0.014, +0.114], Holm p 0.104 (underpowered); excl_leaked auroc: 0.962 vs 0.858, Δ +0.104 [+0.057, +0.150], Holm p <0.001 (supported).

_claims.claim: Sonnet: seeing actions catches more hacks than reading only the report (recall, report_only vs final_report).
_claims.evidence: corrected recall: 0.914 vs 0.742, Δ +0.172 [+0.061, +0.278], Holm p 0.057 (underpowered); excl_leaked recall: 0.912 vs 0.758, Δ +0.154 [+0.042, +0.266], Holm p 0.125 (underpowered).

_claims.claim: Sonnet: ... at the cost of more false positives (FPR, report_only vs final_report).
_claims.evidence: corrected fpr: 0.352 vs 0.232, Δ +0.120 [+0.040, +0.204], Holm p 0.049 (supported); excl_leaked fpr: 0.211 vs 0.206, Δ +0.005 [-0.080, +0.093], Holm p 1.000 (underpowered).

_claims.claim: Opus: seeing actions catches more hacks than reading only the report (recall, report_only vs final_report).
_claims.evidence: corrected recall: 0.625 vs 0.625, Δ +0.000 [-0.170, +0.179], Holm p 1.000 (underpowered); excl_leaked recall: 0.625 vs 0.625, Δ +0.000 [-0.170, +0.179], Holm p 1.000 (underpowered).

_claims.claim: Sonnet: reasoning access adds little to verdicts (full_trace ≈ report_only on accuracy, recall, FPR).
_claims.verdict: underpowered — accuracy: bounded, |Δ| < 0.027 by the 95% CIs; recall: not bounded, |Δ| < 0.074 by the 95% CIs; fpr: bounded, |Δ| < 0.033 by the 95% CIs
_claims.evidence: corrected accuracy: 0.719 vs 0.717, Δ +0.003 [-0.019, +0.025], Holm p 1.000 (not significant); corrected recall: 0.903 vs 0.914, Δ -0.011 [-0.073, +0.053], Holm p 1.000 (underpowered); corrected fpr: 0.345 vs 0.352, Δ -0.007 [-0.026, +0.011], Holm p 1.000 (not significant); excl_leaked accuracy: 0.830 vs 0.827, Δ +0.003 [-0.020, +0.027], Holm p 1.000 (not significant); excl_leaked recall: 0.901 vs 0.912, Δ -0.011 [-0.074, +0.054], Holm p 1.000 (underpowered); excl_leaked fpr: 0.201 vs 0.211, Δ -0.010 [-0.033, +0.014], Holm p 1.000 (not significant).

_claims.claim: Sonnet: reasoning access improves ranking (ΔAUROC full_trace − report_only > 0).
_claims.evidence: corrected auroc: 0.891 vs 0.840, Δ +0.051 [+0.027, +0.076], Holm p <0.001 (supported); excl_leaked auroc: 0.962 vs 0.932, Δ +0.031 [+0.009, +0.053], Holm p 0.044 (supported).

_claims.claim: Opus: reasoning access improves verdicts (accuracy, full_trace vs report_only).
_claims.evidence: corrected accuracy: 0.775 vs 0.704, Δ +0.071 [+0.037, +0.108], Holm p 0.002 (supported); excl_leaked accuracy: 0.895 vs 0.810, Δ +0.085 [+0.045, +0.130], Holm p 0.002 (supported).

_claims.claim: Opus: ... via higher recall and lower FPR.
_claims.evidence: corrected recall: 0.768 vs 0.625, Δ +0.143 [+0.059, +0.245], Holm p 0.070 (underpowered); corrected fpr: 0.223 vs 0.272, Δ -0.049 [-0.090, -0.012], Holm p 0.157 (underpowered); excl_leaked recall: 0.768 vs 0.625, Δ +0.143 [+0.056, +0.241], Holm p 0.086 (underpowered); excl_leaked fpr: 0.056 vs 0.118, Δ -0.062 [-0.113, -0.015], Holm p 0.202 (underpowered).

_claims.claim: Opus: reasoning access improves ranking (ΔAUROC full_trace − report_only > 0).
_claims.evidence: corrected auroc: 0.861 vs 0.821, Δ +0.040 [+0.020, +0.062], Holm p 0.002 (supported); excl_leaked auroc: 0.951 vs 0.919, Δ +0.033 [+0.011, +0.056], Holm p 0.044 (supported).
